title: File delete, review, execute, undo
description: A reversible delete of an old downloaded file. It is high-impact, so it needs a human. The reviewer approves, the action runs, and undo restores the exact prior world. The backend's delete tool takes one path per action, so this is a single-file delete rather than the blueprint's 25-path bulk delete.
user_task: Clean up my old temp files.
